tickets.title: Faction role framework: six roles
tickets.description: Incumbent, Challenger, Parasite, Custodian, Refusenik, Herald as authored roles the seed casts. 5-7 active per world.

tickets.title: Incumbent mapping from the Powers axiom
tickets.description: Administration, Compact, Garrison, Church, plus the Petty kingdoms and No one special cases.

tickets.title: Parasite mapping from the Law axiom
tickets.description: Extraction cartel, Tithe-houses, Stationers, Claim Office, Hoarders, Debt-brokers. One archetype, six faces.

tickets.title: Herald mapping from the Pressure axiom
tickets.description: People who WANT the disaster, not monsters. A political clock can be joined, infiltrated or argued with.

tickets.title: Challenger archetypes: Restorationists, Successors, Levellers
tickets.description: Each with a true diagnosis and a bad prescription.

tickets.title: Custodian archetypes: Keepers and Surveyors
tickets.description: Keepers hold the Cataclysm secret; Surveyors sell map knowledge as their reward currency.

tickets.title: Refusenik archetypes: Renouncers and Wanderers
tickets.description: Renouncers gave up magic and are defenceless; Wanderers hold no territory and can offer services anywhere.

tickets.title: Territory flood-fill with per-faction claim strategies
tickets.description: Resource-following, contiguous-with-distance-decay, nodes-only, defensive-isolated, routes-not-territory, expanding-over-time.

tickets.title: Contested cell identification
tickets.description: Overlapping claims mark the map's content sites — where danger, quests and interesting NPCs go.

tickets.title: Computed hostility matrix
tickets.description: Derive from ideological distance (restore/preserve/replace, control/free/renounce) plus resource overlap. Produces reasoned alliances and exploitable odd bedfellows.

tickets.title: Faction name composition
tickets.description: Role plus a noun the axioms produced (salt, ash, ledger, ore, vigil, tide, ink). Names cohere within a seed automatically.

tickets.title: Faction standing system with gated unlocks
tickets.description: Standing gates trainers, stock, bases and safe passage. The only progression axis that can go negative.

tickets.title: Enforce: at least two factions want strictly incompatible things
tickets.description: Validation pass. If everyone can be satisfied, there was never a decision.

tickets.title: Faction visual identity via material parameters
tickets.description: Colour, silhouette motif and material treatment applied to shared meshes. One guard mesh becomes six factions. Doc 16.

tickets.title: Audible territory layer
tickets.description: Work-bells, patrol horns, silence. Crossing a border becomes audible before it becomes visible. Doc 12.
